_comment: GENERATED by scripts/emit-audit-vectors.mts -- do not hand-edit. Normative seal + verify vectors. vectors: entry_hash = sha256(canonical(core)), entry_hmac = HMAC-SHA256(key_hex, same bytes). verify_vectors: both verifiers must return exactly expect (ok, last_seq) and never throw; anchor, when present, is passed as the external (count, last_hash) anchor; the keyring is {key_id: key_hex} unless the vector gives its own keyring (which may be empty: {} means no keys at all). jsonl_vectors: data_hex is a whole canonical-JSONL file; verify_jsonl must return exactly expect (anchor and keyring as above). jsonl_size_vectors: the file is prefix + unit repeated count times + suffix (UTF-8); value_expect is the verdict of verify_chain on the entries parsed from its lines. derivations: more cases every harness derives, and a conformant verifier must also pass. The cases are every verify vector (its chain), every JSONL vector (its bytes) and every size vector read twice (its file, with expect; its parsed lines as a chain, with value_expect). A case has entry_failure when it is a base case with ok false and no anchor, or any derived case. Apply the rules to every case and to the cases they derive, each rule at most once on a derivation path, up to max_depth rules deep. forged_first: ok false and last_seq >= 0: replace entry 0 by later_entry, a keyless forgery (for a file: line 0 by later_lines_hex[0], its canonical line); expect ok false, last_seq -1. later_failure: entry_failure: append later_entry to a chain (when it is an array), or each of later_lines_hex to a file; expect unchanged. ignored_anchor: entry_failure and no anchor: verify with each of ignored_anchors; expect unchanged. tail_failure: ok true, n = last_seq + 1: append, one at a time, later_entry, a copy of the last entry, a copy of entry 0 and the whole chain again (for a file: each of later_lines_hex and inserted_lines_hex, the last line, line 0 and the whole file again; copies only when n >= 1); expect ok false, last_seq n - 1, as given and, when there is no anchor, also under the true anchor {count: n, last_hash: the last entry_hash, or genesis_hash when n = 0}. head_replay: ok true and n >= 1: insert a copy of entry 0 (line 0) at index 1, and for a file also each of inserted_lines_hex at index 1; expect ok false, last_seq 0. case_count: the number of cases, base and derived; a harness that reaches a different number is not applying the rules.
